item.title: EU AI Act Article 50 Deadline: What Changes on 2 August 2026
item.description: As of today, 2 August 2026, Article 50 of the EU AI Act has stopped being “the thing everyone’s been meaning to prepare for” and is an enforceable transparency obligation. If you publish AI-generated or AI-manipulated content professionally — text, video, audio, social posts — this is the date the disclosure duty starts to bite. Here’s what that means in practice, and what it doesn’t.
